Copper alloy coin. Radiate, possibly of Carausius (286-293), Reece period 14. Obverse description: Radiate bust right. Obverse inscription: IMP C[--]IVS AVG. Reverse description: Figure standing left with vertical spear, possibly Genius. Reverse inscription: possibly [G]ENI[VS--]I. Diameter: 20mm, Weight: 1.97gms, die axis: 12
